noi_dung: Tính giá trị của biểu thức sau: $A = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}+\dfrac{1}{64}$
loi_giai_sach:
Phân tích: Nhận xét thấy mẫu số phân số sau gấp mẫu số phân số ngay trước là 2 lần. Như vậy khi ta nhân thêm 2 vào thì phân số sau sẽ trở thành phân số phía trước.
Ví dụ: $2 \times \dfrac{1}{8} = \dfrac{1}{4}$, như vậy sau khi nhân thêm 2 ta sẽ có 1 loạt các phân số của biểu thức sau khi nhân giống với biểu thức trước khi nhân, rất thuận tiện để ta rút gọn.
Hướng dẫn:
Ta có: $A = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}+\dfrac{1}{64}$ (1)
$A \times 2 = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}+\dfrac{1}{64}\right)$
$A \times 2 = 1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}$ (2)
Nhìn vào (1) và (2), chúng ta nhận xét thấy ở A và A×2 có rất nhiều phân số giống nhau, chỉ khác nhau phân số đầu tiên và phân số cuối cùng. Nếu ta trừ 2 vế cho nhau thì được:
$A \times 2 - A = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}\right) - \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{32}+\dfrac{1}{64}\right)$
$A = 1 - \dfrac{1}{64} = \dfrac{63}{64}$.
Vậy $A = \dfrac{63}{64}$.

noi_dung:
Tính giá trị của các biểu thức sau:
a) $A = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 2}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 3}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{99 \times 100}$
b) $B = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 3}-\dfrac{8}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{12}{5 \times 7}-\ldots-\dfrac{40}{19 \times 21}$
loi_giai_sach:
a) Phân tích: Đây là bài khá cơ bản. Ta thấy các thừa số ở mẫu số có quy luật là $1 \times 2, 2 \times 3, \ldots$ Hơn nữa $2-1=1, 3-2=1, \ldots$ như vậy hiệu hai thừa số ở mẫu số của mỗi phân số đều bằng nhau. Và ta thấy các phân số ở đây đều có sự "liên kết": $1 \times 2, 2 \times 3, 3 \times 4, \ldots$
Ta có: $\dfrac{1}{1 \times 2} = \dfrac{2-1}{1 \times 2} = \dfrac{2}{1 \times 2} - \dfrac{1}{1 \times 2} = \dfrac{1}{1} - \dfrac{1}{2}$
$\dfrac{1}{2 \times 3} = \dfrac{3-2}{2 \times 3} = \dfrac{3}{2 \times 3} - \dfrac{2}{2 \times 3} = \dfrac{1}{2} - \dfrac{1}{3}$
...
$\dfrac{1}{99 \times 100} = \dfrac{1}{99} - \dfrac{1}{100}$
Từ đó ta có: $A = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 2}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 3}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{99 \times 100}$
$A = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{3}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{99}-\dfrac{1}{100} = 1 - \dfrac{1}{100} = \dfrac{99}{100}$.
Vậy $A = \dfrac{99}{100}$.
b) Phân tích: Ở bài này ta thấy các phân số đều có tử số khác 1, mẫu số đã tách thành tích các thừa số "liên kết" nhau, tuy nhiên hiệu hai thừa số ở mẫu số không bằng tử số. Ta nhận xét thấy tổng hai thừa số ở mẫu số đều bằng tử số. Do đó ta nghĩ đến việc đưa về dạng tổng thừa số ở mẫu số bằng tử số $\left(\dfrac{b+a}{a \times b} = \dfrac{1}{a}+\dfrac{1}{b}\right)$
Ta có:
$B = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 3}-\dfrac{8}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{12}{5 \times 7}-\ldots-\dfrac{40}{19 \times 21}$
$B = \dfrac{3+1}{1 \times 3}-\dfrac{5+3}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{7+5}{5 \times 7}-\ldots-\dfrac{21+19}{19 \times 21}$
$B = \left(\dfrac{3}{1 \times 3}+\dfrac{1}{1 \times 3}\right)-\left(\dfrac{5}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{3}{3 \times 5}\right)+\left(\dfrac{7}{5 \times 7}+\dfrac{5}{5 \times 7}\right)-\ldots-\left(\dfrac{21}{19 \times 21}+\dfrac{19}{19 \times 21}\right)$
$B = \left(\dfrac{1}{1}+\dfrac{1}{3}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{5}\right)+\left(\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{7}\right)-\ldots-\left(\dfrac{1}{19}+\dfrac{1}{21}\right)$
$B = \dfrac{1}{1}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{7}-\ldots-\dfrac{1}{19}-\dfrac{1}{21} = 1 - \dfrac{1}{21} = \dfrac{20}{21}$
Vậy $B = \dfrac{20}{21}$.

Tìm $x$ biết:
a) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{4}\right) \times x = 1+\dfrac{2}{3}+\dfrac{1}{2}$
b) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{4}\right) : x = \left(\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{12}\right)$
c) $\left(\dfrac{4}{7}+\dfrac{2}{3}\right) : \left(x+\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = 1\dfrac{1}{7}+1\dfrac{1}{3}$
d) $\dfrac{3}{5}+\dfrac{2}{7} : x = 1$
e) $\dfrac{6}{5}-x : \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}$
loi_giai_sach:
a) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{4}\right) \times x = 1+\dfrac{2}{3}+\dfrac{1}{2}$
$x = \left(1+\dfrac{2}{3}+\dfrac{1}{2}\right) : \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{4}\right)$
$x = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{4}\right) : \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{4}\right)$
$x = 2$
b) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{4}\right) : x = \left(\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{12}\right)$
$x = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{4}\right) : \left(\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{12}\right)$
$x = 3 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{12}\right) : \left(\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{12}\right)$
$x = 3$
c) $\left(\dfrac{4}{7}+\dfrac{2}{3}\right) : \left(x+\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = 1\dfrac{1}{7}+1\dfrac{1}{3}$
$\left(\dfrac{4}{7}+\dfrac{2}{3}\right) : \left(x+\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = \dfrac{8}{7}+\dfrac{4}{3}$
$x+\dfrac{1}{2} = \left(\dfrac{4}{7}+\dfrac{2}{3}\right) : \left(\dfrac{8}{7}+\dfrac{4}{3}\right)$
$x+\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \left(\dfrac{8}{7}+\dfrac{4}{3}\right) : \left(\dfrac{8}{7}+\dfrac{4}{3}\right)$
$x+\dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{2}$
$x = 0$
d) $\dfrac{3}{5}+\dfrac{2}{7} : x = 1$
$\dfrac{2}{7} : x = 1-\dfrac{3}{5}$
$\dfrac{2}{7} : x = \dfrac{2}{5}$
$x = \dfrac{2}{7} : \dfrac{2}{5}$
$x = \dfrac{2}{7} \times \dfrac{5}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{5}{7}$
e) $\dfrac{6}{5}-x : \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}$
$x : \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{6}{5}-\dfrac{1}{2}$
$x : \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{7}{10}$
$x = \dfrac{7}{10} \times \dfrac{1}{2}$
$x = \dfrac{7}{20}$

noi_dung:
Tính giá trị các biểu thức sau:
a) $A = 1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\dfrac{1}{625}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{78125}$
b) $B = \dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{48}+\dfrac{1}{192}+\dfrac{1}{768}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{36864}$
c) $C = \dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\dfrac{5}{24}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{192}+\dfrac{5}{384}$
d) $D = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 3}+\dfrac{4}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{4}{5 \times 7}+\ldots+\dfrac{4}{49 \times 51}$
e) $E = \dfrac{1}{2 \times 5}+\dfrac{1}{5 \times 8}+\dfrac{1}{8 \times 11}+\dfrac{1}{11 \times 14}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{98 \times 101}$
f) $F = \dfrac{2}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{2}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{2}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{2}{81 \times 85}$
g) $G = \dfrac{3}{4 \times 9}+\dfrac{3}{9 \times 14}+\dfrac{3}{14 \times 19}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{34 \times 39}$
loi_giai_sach:
a) Ta có: $A = 1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\dfrac{1}{625}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}+\dfrac{1}{78\,125}$
$A \times 5 = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\dfrac{1}{625}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}+\dfrac{1}{78\,125}\right) \times 5$
$A \times 5 = 5+1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}$
$A \times 5 - A = \left(5+1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}\right) - \left(1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\dfrac{1}{625}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}+\dfrac{1}{78\,125}\right)$
$A \times 4 = 5+\left(1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}\right)-\left(1+\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{25}+\dfrac{1}{125}+\dfrac{1}{625}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15\,625}\right)-\dfrac{1}{78\,125}$
$A \times 4 = 5-\dfrac{1}{78\,125}$
$A \times 4 = \dfrac{390\,625}{78\,125}-\dfrac{1}{78\,125}$
$A \times 4 = \dfrac{390\,624}{78\,125}$
$A = \dfrac{390\,624}{78\,125} : 4$
$A = \dfrac{97\,656}{78\,125}$
b) $B = \dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{48}+\dfrac{1}{192}+\dfrac{1}{768}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{36864}$
Ta có: $B \times 4 = \dfrac{4}{3}+\dfrac{4}{12}+\dfrac{4}{48}+\dfrac{4}{192}+\dfrac{4}{768}+\ldots+\dfrac{4}{36864}$
$B \times 4 = \dfrac{4}{3}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{48}+\dfrac{1}{192}+\dfrac{1}{768}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{9216}$
Do đó:
$B \times 4 - B = \left(\dfrac{4}{3}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{48}+\dfrac{1}{192}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{9216}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{48}+\dfrac{1}{192}+\dfrac{1}{768}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{36864}\right)$
$B \times 3 = \dfrac{4}{3}-\dfrac{1}{36864}$
$B \times 3 = \dfrac{49151}{36864}$
$B = \dfrac{49151}{36864} : 3$
$B = \dfrac{49151}{110592}$
c) $C = \dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\dfrac{5}{24}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{192}+\dfrac{5}{384}$
$C \times 2 = \left(\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\dfrac{5}{24}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{192}+\dfrac{5}{384}\right) \times 2$
$C \times 2 = \dfrac{10}{3}+\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{96}+\dfrac{5}{192}$
Do đó:
$C \times 2 - C = \left(\dfrac{10}{3}+\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{96}+\dfrac{5}{192}\right)-\left(\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\dfrac{5}{24}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{192}+\dfrac{5}{384}\right)$
$C = \dfrac{10}{3}+\left(\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{96}+\dfrac{5}{192}\right)-\left(\dfrac{5}{3}+\dfrac{5}{6}+\dfrac{5}{12}+\dfrac{5}{24}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{192}\right)-\dfrac{5}{384}$
$C = \dfrac{10}{3}-\dfrac{5}{384}$
$C = \dfrac{1280}{384}-\dfrac{5}{384}$
$C = \dfrac{1275}{384}$
$C = \dfrac{425}{128}$
d) $D = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 3}+\dfrac{4}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{4}{5 \times 7}+\ldots+\dfrac{4}{49 \times 51}$
$D = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{2}{1 \times 3}+\dfrac{2}{3 \times 5}+\dfrac{2}{5 \times 7}+\ldots+\dfrac{2}{49 \times 51}\right)$
$D = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}-\dfrac{1}{7}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{49}-\dfrac{1}{51}\right)$
$D = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{51}\right)$
$D = 2 \times \dfrac{50}{51}$
$D = \dfrac{100}{51}$
e) $E = \dfrac{1}{2 \times 5}+\dfrac{1}{5 \times 8}+\dfrac{1}{8 \times 11}+\dfrac{1}{11 \times 14}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{98 \times 101}$
$E \times 3 = \dfrac{3}{2 \times 5}+\dfrac{3}{5 \times 8}+\dfrac{3}{8 \times 11}+\dfrac{3}{11 \times 14}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{98 \times 101}$
$E \times 3 = \dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}-\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{8}-\dfrac{1}{11}+\dfrac{1}{11}-\dfrac{1}{14}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{98}-\dfrac{1}{101}$
$E \times 3 = \dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{101}$
$E \times 3 = \dfrac{99}{202}$
$E = \dfrac{99}{202} : 3$
$E = \dfrac{33}{202}$
f) $F = \dfrac{2}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{2}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{2}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{2}{81 \times 85}$
$F \times 2 = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{4}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{4}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{4}{81 \times 85}$
$F \times 2 = 1-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}-\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{13}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{81}-\dfrac{1}{85}$
$F \times 2 = 1-\dfrac{1}{85}$
$F \times 2 = \dfrac{84}{85}$
$F = \dfrac{84}{85} : 2$
$F = \dfrac{42}{85}$
g) $G = \dfrac{3}{4 \times 9}+\dfrac{3}{9 \times 14}+\dfrac{3}{14 \times 19}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{34 \times 39}$
$G \times \dfrac{5}{3} = \left(\dfrac{3}{4 \times 9}+\dfrac{3}{9 \times 14}+\dfrac{3}{14 \times 19}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{34 \times 39}\right) \times \dfrac{5}{3}$
$G \times \dfrac{5}{3} = \dfrac{5}{4 \times 9}+\dfrac{5}{9 \times 14}+\dfrac{5}{14 \times 19}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{34 \times 39}$
$G \times \dfrac{5}{3} = \dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{14}+\dfrac{1}{14}-\dfrac{1}{19}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{34}-\dfrac{1}{39}$
$G \times \dfrac{5}{3} = \dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{39}$
$G \times \dfrac{5}{3} = \dfrac{35}{156}$
$G = \dfrac{35}{156} : \dfrac{5}{3}$
$G = \dfrac{7}{52}$

loi_giai_sach:
a) $\left(y+\dfrac{1}{2}\right)+\left(y+\dfrac{1}{4}\right)-\left(y+\dfrac{1}{8}\right)+\left(y+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) = 1$
$y+\dfrac{1}{2}+y+\dfrac{1}{4}+y+\dfrac{1}{8}-y+\dfrac{1}{16} = 1$
$(y+y+y+y)+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) = 1$
$y \times 4+\left(\dfrac{8}{16}+\dfrac{4}{16}+\dfrac{2}{16}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) = 1$
$y \times 4+\dfrac{15}{16} = 1$
$y \times 4 = 1-\dfrac{15}{16}$
$y \times 4 = \dfrac{1}{16}$
$y = \dfrac{1}{16} : 4$
$y = \dfrac{1}{64}$
Vậy $y = \dfrac{1}{64}$.
b) $\left(y+\dfrac{1}{2}\right)+\left(y+\dfrac{1}{4}\right)+\left(y+\dfrac{1}{8}\right)+\ldots+\left(y+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right) = 1$
$(y+y+\ldots+y)+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right) = 1$ (10 số y)
$y \times 10+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right) = 1$
Đặt $A = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}$, ta có:
$A \times 2 = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right) \times 2$
$A \times 2 = 1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}$
$A \times 2 - A = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)$
$A = 1+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\dfrac{1}{1024}$
$A = 1-\dfrac{1}{1024}$
$A = \dfrac{1023}{1024}$
Do đó: $y \times 10+\dfrac{1023}{1024} = 1$
$y \times 10 = 1-\dfrac{1023}{1024}$
$y \times 10 = \dfrac{1}{1024}$
$y = \dfrac{1}{1024} : 10$
$y = \dfrac{1}{10\,240}$
Vậy $y = \dfrac{1}{10\,240}$.

loi_giai_sach:
$\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) : x = \dfrac{3}{1 \times 2}+\dfrac{3}{2 \times 3}+\dfrac{3}{3 \times 4}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{15 \times 16}$
$\left(1-\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{8}-\dfrac{1}{16}\right) : x = 3 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1 \times 2}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 3}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15 \times 16}\right)$
$\left(1-\dfrac{1}{16}\right) : x = 3 \times \left(1-\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{3}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{15}-\dfrac{1}{16}\right)$
$\dfrac{15}{16} : x = 3 \times \left(1-\dfrac{1}{16}\right)$
$\dfrac{15}{16} : x = 3 \times \dfrac{15}{16}$
$\dfrac{15}{16} : x = \dfrac{45}{16}$
$x = \dfrac{15}{16} : \dfrac{45}{16}$
$x = \dfrac{1}{3}$
Vậy $x = \dfrac{1}{3}$.

a) Ta có: $A = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}+\dfrac{1}{2048}$
$A \times 2 = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}+\dfrac{1}{2048}\right) \times 2$
$A \times 2 = 1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}$
Do đó: $A \times 2 - A = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}+\dfrac{1}{2048}\right)$
$A = 1+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)-\dfrac{1}{2048}$
$A = 1-\dfrac{1}{2048} < 1$
Vậy $A < 1$.
b) Ta có: $B = \dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}+\dfrac{1}{6561}$
$B \times 3 = \left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}+\dfrac{1}{6561}\right) \times 3$
$B \times 3 = 1+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{729}+\dfrac{1}{2187}$
Do đó: $B \times 3 - B = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{729}+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}+\dfrac{1}{6561}\right)$
$B \times 2 = 1+\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{729}+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\dfrac{1}{6561}$
$B \times 2 = 1-\dfrac{1}{6561} < 1$
Vì $B \times 2 < 1$ nên $B < \dfrac{1}{2}$.
Vậy $B < \dfrac{1}{2}$.

noi_dung:
Tính giá trị các biểu thức sau:
a) $A = \dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{24}+\dfrac{1}{40}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{4900}$
b) $B = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{14}+\dfrac{1}{35}+\dfrac{1}{65}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{4850}$
c) $C = \dfrac{3}{10}+\dfrac{3}{90}+\dfrac{3}{234}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{1050}$
d) $D = \dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{66}+\dfrac{1}{176}+\dfrac{1}{336}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1886}$
e) $E = \dfrac{3}{2}+\dfrac{5}{4}+\dfrac{9}{8}+\dfrac{17}{16}+\ldots+\dfrac{1025}{1024}$
f) $F = 1-\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{81}-\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{6561}-\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$
loi_giai_sach:
a) Ta có: $A = \dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{24}+\dfrac{1}{40}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{4900}$
$A = \dfrac{2}{8}+\dfrac{2}{24}+\dfrac{2}{48}+\dfrac{2}{80}+\ldots+\dfrac{2}{9800}$
$A = \dfrac{2}{2 \times 4}+\dfrac{2}{4 \times 6}+\dfrac{2}{6 \times 8}+\dfrac{2}{8 \times 10}+\ldots+\dfrac{2}{98 \times 100}$
$A = \dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{6}-\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{8}-\dfrac{1}{10}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{98}-\dfrac{1}{100}$
$A = \dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{100}$
$A = \dfrac{49}{100}$
b) Ta có: $B = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{14}+\dfrac{1}{35}+\dfrac{1}{65}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{4850}$
$B \times \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{28}+\dfrac{1}{70}+\dfrac{1}{130}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{9700}$
$B \times \dfrac{1}{2} = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 4}+\dfrac{1}{4 \times 7}+\dfrac{1}{7 \times 10}+\dfrac{1}{10 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{97 \times 100}$
$B \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times 3 = \dfrac{3}{1 \times 4}+\dfrac{3}{4 \times 7}+\dfrac{3}{7 \times 10}+\dfrac{3}{10 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{97 \times 100}$
$B \times \dfrac{3}{2} = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{7}+\dfrac{1}{7}-\dfrac{1}{10}+\dfrac{1}{10}-\dfrac{1}{13}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{97}-\dfrac{1}{100}$
$B \times \dfrac{3}{2} = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{100}$
$B \times \dfrac{3}{2} = \dfrac{99}{100}$
$B = \dfrac{99}{100} : \dfrac{3}{2}$
$B = \dfrac{33}{50}$
c) Ta có: $C = \dfrac{3}{10}+\dfrac{3}{90}+\dfrac{3}{234}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{1050}$
$C \times 2 = \left(\dfrac{3}{10}+\dfrac{3}{90}+\dfrac{3}{234}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{1050}\right) \times 2$
$C \times 2 = \dfrac{3}{5}+\dfrac{3}{45}+\dfrac{3}{117}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{525}$
$C \times 2 = \dfrac{3}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{3}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{3}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{21 \times 25}$
$C \times 2 \times \dfrac{4}{3} = \left(\dfrac{3}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{3}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{3}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{21 \times 25}\right) \times \dfrac{4}{3}$
$C \times \dfrac{8}{3} = \dfrac{4}{1 \times 5}+\dfrac{4}{5 \times 9}+\dfrac{4}{9 \times 13}+\ldots+\dfrac{4}{21 \times 25}$
$C \times \dfrac{8}{3} = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{5}+\dfrac{1}{5}-\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{13}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{21}-\dfrac{1}{25}$
$C \times \dfrac{8}{3} = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{25}$
$C \times \dfrac{8}{3} = \dfrac{24}{25}$
$C = \dfrac{24}{25} : \dfrac{8}{3}$
$C = \dfrac{9}{25}$
d) Ta có: $D = \dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{66}+\dfrac{1}{176}+\dfrac{1}{336}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1886}$
$D = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 6}+\dfrac{1}{6 \times 11}+\dfrac{1}{11 \times 16}+\dfrac{1}{16 \times 21}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{41 \times 46}$
$D \times 5 = \left(\dfrac{1}{1 \times 6}+\dfrac{1}{6 \times 11}+\dfrac{1}{11 \times 16}+\dfrac{1}{16 \times 21}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{41 \times 46}\right) \times 5$
$D \times 5 = \dfrac{5}{1 \times 6}+\dfrac{5}{6 \times 11}+\dfrac{5}{11 \times 16}+\dfrac{5}{16 \times 21}+\ldots+\dfrac{5}{41 \times 46}$
$D \times 5 = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{6}-\dfrac{1}{11}+\dfrac{1}{11}-\dfrac{1}{16}+\dfrac{1}{16}-\dfrac{1}{21}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{41}-\dfrac{1}{46}$
$D \times 5 = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{46}$
$D \times 5 = \dfrac{45}{46}$
$D = \dfrac{45}{46} : 5$
$D = \dfrac{9}{46}$
e) Ta có: $E = \dfrac{3}{2}+\dfrac{5}{4}+\dfrac{9}{8}+\dfrac{17}{16}+\ldots+\dfrac{1025}{1024}$
$E = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}\right)+\left(1+\dfrac{1}{4}\right)+\left(1+\dfrac{1}{8}\right)+\left(1+\dfrac{1}{16}\right)+\ldots+\left(1+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)$
$E = (1+1+\ldots+1)+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)$ (10 số 1)
$E = 10+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)$
Đặt $M = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}$, ta có:
$M \times 2 = \left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right) \times 2$
$M \times 2 = 1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}$
$M \times 2 - M = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}+\dfrac{1}{1024}\right)$
$M = 1+\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{256}+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{512}\right)-\dfrac{1}{1024}$
$M = 1-\dfrac{1}{1024}$
$M = \dfrac{1023}{1024}$
Do đó $E = 10+\dfrac{1023}{1024} = 10\dfrac{1023}{1024}$.
f) Ta có: $F = 1-\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{9}-\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{81}-\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{6561}-\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$
$F = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{9}+\dfrac{1}{81}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{6561}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}\right)$
$F = \left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}\right) \times 3-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}\right)$
$F = \left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}\right) \times 2$
Đặt $N = \dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$, ta có:
$N \times 9 = 3+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}$
$N \times 9 - N = \left(3+\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}+\dfrac{1}{19\,683}\right)$
$N \times 8 = 3+\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{27}+\dfrac{1}{243}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{2187}\right)-\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$
$N \times 8 = 3-\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$
$N \times 8 = \dfrac{59\,049}{19\,683}-\dfrac{1}{19\,683}$
$N \times 8 = \dfrac{59\,048}{19\,683}$
$N = \dfrac{59\,048}{19\,683} : 8$
$N = \dfrac{7381}{19\,683}$
Do đó $F = N \times 2 = \dfrac{7381}{19\,683} \times 2 = \dfrac{14\,762}{19\,683}$.

noi_dung:
Tìm y biết:
a) $y \times \left(\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{28}+\dfrac{1}{70}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{550}\right) = 1$
b) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) \times y = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{20}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{132}$
loi_giai_sach:
a) $y \times \left(\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{28}+\dfrac{1}{70}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{550}\right) = 1$
$y \times 3 \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1 \times 4}+\dfrac{1}{4 \times 7}+\dfrac{1}{7 \times 10}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{22 \times 25}\right) = 1 \times 3$
$y \times \left(\dfrac{3}{1 \times 4}+\dfrac{3}{4 \times 7}+\dfrac{3}{7 \times 10}+\ldots+\dfrac{3}{22 \times 25}\right) = 3$
$y \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{7}+\dfrac{1}{7}-\dfrac{1}{10}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{22}-\dfrac{1}{25}\right) = 3$
$y \times \left(\dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{25}\right) = 3$
$y \times \dfrac{24}{25} = 3$
$y = 3 : \dfrac{24}{25}$
$y = 3 \times \dfrac{25}{24}$
$y = \dfrac{25}{8}$
Vậy $y = \dfrac{25}{8}$.
b) $\left(\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{4}+\dfrac{1}{8}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) \times y = \dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{6}+\dfrac{1}{12}+\dfrac{1}{20}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{132}$
$\left(\dfrac{8}{16}+\dfrac{4}{16}+\dfrac{2}{16}+\dfrac{1}{16}\right) \times y = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 2}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 3}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 4}+\dfrac{1}{4 \times 5}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{11 \times 12}$
$\dfrac{15}{16} \times y = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{3}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{4}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{11}-\dfrac{1}{12}$
$\dfrac{15}{16} \times y = \dfrac{1}{1}-\dfrac{1}{12}$
$\dfrac{15}{16} \times y = \dfrac{11}{12}$
$y = \dfrac{11}{12} : \dfrac{15}{16}$
$y = \dfrac{44}{45}$
Vậy $y = \dfrac{44}{45}$.

loi_giai_sach:
Ta có: $A = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 300}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 301}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 302}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{101 \times 400}$
$A \times 299 = \dfrac{299}{1 \times 300}+\dfrac{299}{2 \times 301}+\dfrac{299}{3 \times 302}+\ldots+\dfrac{299}{101 \times 400}$
$A \times 299 = 1-\dfrac{1}{300}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{301}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{302}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{101}-\dfrac{1}{400}$
$A \times 299 = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{101}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{300}+\dfrac{1}{301}+\dfrac{1}{302}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{400}\right)$
Lại có: $B = \dfrac{1}{1 \times 102}+\dfrac{1}{2 \times 103}+\dfrac{1}{3 \times 104}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{299 \times 400}$
$B \times 101 = \dfrac{101}{1 \times 102}+\dfrac{101}{2 \times 103}+\dfrac{101}{3 \times 104}+\ldots+\dfrac{101}{299 \times 400}$
$B \times 101 = 1-\dfrac{1}{102}+\dfrac{1}{2}-\dfrac{1}{103}+\dfrac{1}{3}-\dfrac{1}{104}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{299}-\dfrac{1}{400}$
$B \times 101 = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{299}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{102}+\dfrac{1}{103}+\dfrac{1}{104}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{400}\right)$
$B \times 101 = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{101}+\dfrac{1}{102}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{299}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{102}+\dfrac{1}{103}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{299}+\dfrac{1}{300}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{400}\right)$
$B \times 101 = \left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}+\dfrac{1}{3}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{101}\right)-\left(\dfrac{1}{300}+\dfrac{1}{301}+\dfrac{1}{302}+\ldots+\dfrac{1}{400}\right)$
Do đó: $A \times 299 = B \times 101$.
Vậy: $\dfrac{A}{B} = \dfrac{101}{299}$.
